verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents two product-native bulk-creation paths. Spreadsheet Import is listed on its pricing page, and a support article covers "Add Multiple Companies Using Template", both of which let a user load many records at once. Beyond these titles there is no detail, and nothing shows bulk edits or actions on existing items; white-glove migration is a vendor service rather than a user capability. Missing for 10: bulk edit/update/delete of existing stakeholders or transactions, bulk issuance or signing actions, programmatic/API-driven batch operations, any documentation depth beyond titles, independent or hands-on corroboration.
